1. (Currently amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, __wherein said fins are integrally formed with said columnar body and extend radially outward therefrom, and wherein said light emitting diodes are mounted directly to said columnar body between adjacent fins__.

2. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open __and said columnar body is sealed at said first end by said base member__.

3. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 further including a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes, __wherein said optic element is a unitary component that covers and encapsulates said diodes and is optically bonded to said columnar body__.

4. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material __and said phosphor material is distributed throughout said optic element to provide wavelength conversion__.

5. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body __and are positioned at equal angular intervals__.

6. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __such that each fin is positioned equidistant from adjacent diodes__.

7. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section __and has a length-to-width ratio of at least 3:1__.

8. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body __and said diodes are positioned in the center of each face__.

9. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body __and said fins are integrally formed with said columnar body__.

10. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face __and said single diode on each face is positioned centrally and equidistant from adjacent corners__.

11. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK __and said material comprises aluminum or copper alloy__.

12. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single optic element is disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode __and each optic element is optically isolated from adjacent optic elements__.

13. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base __and is configured to mate with standard lighting fixtures__.

14. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current __and further includes a current limiting circuit for regulating power to said diodes__.

15. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body __and said optic element has a refractive index greater than 1.4__.

16. (Currently amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline, __wherein said diodes are directly mounted to said polygonal body and said fins are integrally formed with said body__.

17. (Currently amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode, __wherein said fins are integrally formed during the extrusion process__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/mK __and comprises aluminum alloy__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins __formed during extrusion and positioned at equal angular intervals__.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body has substantially straight side walls __and uniform wall thickness__.
